name: Pronomos Capital

summary.text: Pronomos Capital is a San Francisco venture fund founded in 2019 by Patri Friedman, a former Google engineer, grandson of Milton Friedman and co-founder of the Seasteading Institute, to invest in charter cities and what its materials call alternative jurisdictions. Bloomberg Businessweek reported in December 2019 that Peter Thiel was the firm's anchor investor; The Daily Beast reported in 2023 that it had raised at least $13.3 million from backers including Thiel and Marc Andreessen. Its portfolio page lists Próspera (Honduras), Praxis Society, Yung Drung City and Small Farm Cities.

facts.claim: Pronomos Capital was founded in 2019 by Patri Friedman. In a 2020 podcast episode Friedman described it as the first venture fund dedicated to charter cities.
facts.quote: the first venture fund dedicated to charter cities

sources.title: Pronomos Capital's New VC Idea: Colonies of Tech Bros

facts.claim: Bloomberg Businessweek reported in December 2019 that Friedman, a former Google engineer and grandson of Milton Friedman who co-founded the Seasteading Institute, started Pronomos Capital with money from Peter Thiel to establish what the article called mini-city-states, and that Thiel had become the anchor investor of the new firm even though he had not funded the Seasteading Institute for at least five years.
facts.quote: He started Pronomos Capital with more money from Peter Thiel, to establish mini-city-states.

sources.title: Silicon Valley Seasteaders Go Looking for Low-Tax Sites on Land

facts.claim: Friedman's biography on the Foresight Institute site describes him as Founder and General Partner of Pronomos Capital, a Silicon Valley venture firm backed by Peter Thiel that invests in charter cities and alternative jurisdictions.
facts.quote: Founder and General Partner of Pronomos Capital, a Silicon Valley venture firm backed by Peter Thiel that invests in charter cities and alternative jurisdictions.

sources.title: Patri Friedman

facts.claim: The Daily Beast reported in December 2023 that Pronomos had raised at least $13.3 million from backers including Peter Thiel and Marc Andreessen.
facts.quote: has raised at least $13.3 million from free-market evangelists including Peter Thiel and Marc Andreessen

sources.title: Pronomos Capital's New VC Idea: Colonies of Tech Bros

facts.claim: Pronomos says it invests in charter cities with the goal of building prosperity hubs, providing seed capital meant to fund feasibility studies, marketing materials, legislation and other steps toward raising further financing. It says it looks for seed-stage charter-city projects, typically with some government cooperation, strong existing partnerships and a business model.
facts.quote: invests in the charter cities of tomorrow, with the goal of building prosperity hubs that grow to empower entire nations

facts.claim: Pronomos's portfolio page lists Próspera, described as the first modern startup city in operation under Honduras's ZEDE program, together with Yung Drung City in South Asia, Praxis Society's planned Mediterranean city, and Small Farm Cities in Africa.
facts.quote: the first modern startup city in operation, designed around human-centered governance, operating under Honduras' ZEDE program

sources.title: Portfolio

facts.claim: The Daily Beast reported that Pronomos invested in the startup-city project Praxis in 2021, and that Praxis had raised nearly $20 million from investors including Pronomos, Balaji Srinivasan, the Winklevoss twins and Sam Bankman-Fried without, as of December 2023, making physical headway or announcing a location.
facts.quote: Despite raising nearly $20 million from investors like Pronomos, Srinivasan, the Winklevoss twins, and now-disgraced Sam Bankman-Fried, Praxis has yet to make any physical headway.

facts.claim: A 2022 press release by Metropolis, a company announcing backing from Friedman and Pronomos, stated that Pronomos's backers include Peter Thiel and Balaji Srinivasan. This is a portfolio company's statement, not Pronomos's own disclosure.
facts.quote: backers of Pronomos include Peter Thiel and Balaji Srinivasin, among other leaders

sources.title: Metropolis "Digital Nations" Platform Announces Backing by Patri Friedman and Pronomos Capital

facts.claim: In his LinkedIn post announcing Pronomos Capital, Friedman listed Naval Ravikant among the firm's advisors, separately from its investors. No source reviewed names Ravikant as a financial backer.

sources.title: Patri Friedman on LinkedIn: Pronomos Capital

facts.claim: Friedman founded the Seasteading Institute in 2008 to promote self-governing communities at sea; The Daily Beast put Thiel's investment in the institute at $1.7 million, and Bloomberg reported in 2019 that Thiel had not written it a check in at least five years and that a 2018 attempt at a seastead off Tahiti was stopped by local opposition.
facts.quote: Thiel hasn't written the institute a check in at least five years

openQuestions: Itana (Nigeria, Lekki Free Trade Zone) appears in aggregator profiles (PitchBook, Tracxn) as a 2023 Pronomos pre-seed investment and is described in The Daily Beast's article, but the fund's own portfolio page did not list it in the text retrieved; not recorded as a connection.

Fund size and backers beyond Thiel and Andreessen rest on a single Daily Beast report ($13.3 million); no SEC Form D or Pronomos disclosure was retrieved. Sam Altman is named as a backer of Próspera's venture funders by NYT Magazine (2024) but not tied to Pronomos by any source reviewed.
Founders Fund is not named by any source reviewed as a Pronomos backer; the brief's 'backed by Founders Fund' is unsupported on this record.
The Bloomberg Businessweek 2019 article was only partly retrieved (opening section); the full text may add detail on sites and tax terms.
Marc Andreessen as a Pronomos backer rests on The Daily Beast alone; a second source would strengthen it.
